name: employees inherit the strongest direct grant in their manager chain
input: a three-level reporting tree with direct and inherited grants
test:
manager = EmployeeGrantManager()
manager.add_employee('lead')
manager.add_employee('senior', 'lead')
manager.add_employee('dev', 'senior')
manager.grant('lead', 'model-registry', 'write')
assert manager.access_level('dev', 'model-registry') == 'write'
manager.grant('dev', 'model-registry', 'read')
assert manager.access_level('dev', 'model-registry') == 'write'
manager.grant('senior', 'model-registry', 'admin')
assert manager.access_level('dev', 'model-registry') == 'admin'
assert manager.allowed('dev', 'model-registry', 'write') is True
assert manager.allowed('lead', 'model-registry', 'admin') is False

name: revoking and reparenting update effective access immediately
input: a report moves from one lead to another after a direct-grant removal
test:
manager = EmployeeGrantManager()
manager.add_employee('a')
manager.add_employee('b')
manager.add_employee('dev', 'a')
manager.grant('a', 'deploy', 'admin')
manager.grant('b', 'deploy', 'read')
manager.grant('dev', 'deploy', 'write')
assert manager.revoke('dev', 'deploy') is True
assert manager.revoke('dev', 'deploy') is False
assert manager.access_level('dev', 'deploy') == 'admin'
manager.set_manager('dev', 'b')
assert manager.access_level('dev', 'deploy') == 'read'
assert manager.audit('deploy') == [('a', 'admin'), ('b', 'read'), ('dev', 'read')]

name: cycle attempts fail atomically
input: a root, child, and grandchild followed by invalid reporting changes
test:
manager = EmployeeGrantManager()
manager.add_employee("root")
manager.add_employee("child", "root")
manager.add_employee("grandchild", "child")
manager.grant("root", "data", "read")
for call in (
    lambda: manager.set_manager("root", "grandchild"),
    lambda: manager.set_manager("child", "child"),
):
    try:
        call()
    except (ValueError, AssertionError):
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("expected input validation error")
assert manager.access_level("grandchild", "data") == "read"
assert manager.audit("data") == [
    ("child", "read"),
    ("grandchild", "read"),
    ("root", "read"),
]
